label: EXPLORATORY_PILOT
research_question: Is the RV-only baseline (B0_rv_only) reliably miscalibrated out-of-sample on modeled liquidation-boundary breach risk, and can a train-only recalibration layer materially improve Brier score and ECE across multiple chronological holdouts and transfer across scenarios beyond a label-permutation placebo?

outcome.explicit_caveat: Never call these observed liquidations; they are modeled boundary crossings on cached 1h mark prices.
outcome.label_matrix_reused: fclr_risk06_labels_20261118T182813Z.json (262080 rows; rebuilt features only, labels not recomputed)

sealed_month_policy: 2024-10 onward are sealed and are not read; only 2024-04..2024-09 labels and 2024-03..2024-09 marks/funding are read.

base_score.name: B0_rv_only
base_score.family: stdlib IRLS logistic regression with intercept
base_score.standardization: train-only z-score (mean/sd from rows used to fit that fold/model only)
base_score.pooling: pooled across the 5 instruments within the train window, one model per scenario
base_score.must_reproduce: RISK-06 test Brier for the same holdout/scenario (C0_identity reference)

calibrators.definition: sigmoid(a*logit(s)+b), fitted by IRLS with ridge 1e-6
PAVA isotonic regression on out-of-fold (s,y) with tie pooling, monotone step map, linear interpolation between knots, clipped to [0,1]

leakage_control.oof_scheme: 5 contiguous UTC-day-block folds inside the train window; each fold model trained on the other four folds; no shuffling across days
leakage_control.final_base_model: refit on the full train window to produce test scores
prohibitions: never fit a calibrator on test rows
never fit a calibrator on in-sample train predictions

secondary: ECE (10 equal-count bins, bins with <30 rows merged, bin count reported)
metrics.diag_rule: reliability slope/intercept from a 1-D logistic fit on test scores are diagnostic only and are never used for tuning

uncertainty.ece_reps_note: ECE requires re-binning each resample; 400 exact-recompute reps are pre-registered for ΔECE CIs while ΔBrier uses 2000 per-day-sum reps

cross_scenario_transfer.rule: for C1 and C3, fit the calibrator on scenario A train out-of-fold scores and apply it to scenario B test scores; report mean delta_brier over all ordered pairs A!=B on the holdout and whether the sign agrees with own-scenario calibration

placebo.method: permute train labels within scenario AFTER out-of-fold scores are computed; refit each calibrator on permuted train scores; apply to the real test set
placebo.report: placebo null mean and 95th percentile of mean delta_brier (pooled and primary scenario)

materiality_floor.rule: All three required: (1) C1 or C3 achieves delta_brier > 0 with bootstrap CI95 lower bound > 0 in >=2 of 3 holdouts on L10|long|H24; (2) mean delta_ECE >= 0.005 in >=2 of 3 holdouts with the min-bin guard satisfied; (3) the real mean delta_brier exceeds the 95th percentile of the label-permutation placebo null.
